audit.why: Emerald+ 51.06% over 803 games and both charts hand Jayce Levels 1-2 and Morde Level 3 and 6. That matches the kits: Jayce out-ranges everything Morde has until Death's Grasp (700 range) and Realm of Death (650) exist, and has no answer to either once they do.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every spike is described by name only — no cooldown anywhere, so 'his poke margin shrinks' and 'never sit in E-range' have no timer attached.
audit.why: The numbers are what make this lane playable. Death's Grasp is 16/14/12/10/8 at 700 range, Obliterate 8/7/6/5/4 at 675, Indestructible 12/11/10/9/8, Realm of Death 140/120/100 at 650. So at Level 3 the pull is a 16-second cooldown you can simply wait out, and the whole lane is 'poke, eat the E, poke again for 16 seconds'. At Level 6 the number that matters is 140: after Realm of Death is spent you own the next two minutes outright. Without those figures the page tells the player to be afraid without telling them when to stop being afraid.
audit.corrected: Death's Grasp 16s at rank 1 and Realm of Death 140s at rank 1 are now stated as the two windows the lane is traded around.

audit.whatIsWrong: Realm of Death is described as banishing you to a 1v1, but the 650-unit cast range is never given, and Death's Grasp's 700-unit pull is called 'E-range' without a number.
audit.why: Riot's Realm of Death is a 650-range targeted drag. Jayce's Shock Blast is fired from Cannon stance well outside that, so the practical rule is not 'never sit in E-range at full HP' but a distance: stay past 700 and neither the pull nor the ult can start. Death's Grasp is the longer of the two, so 700 is the single number that keeps you safe from both, and it is the number the page never gives.
audit.corrected: Stated as a 700-unit line: outside it, Death's Grasp cannot pull and Realm of Death at 650 cannot reach.

audit.whatIsWrong: Indestructible is treated purely as a heal that undoes poke; the mechanic that decides whether your poke is wasted is not stated.
audit.why: Riot's text: Mordekaiser 'stores damage he deals and takes to create a shield. He may consume the shield to heal.' The shield is built out of the damage you deal him — so uninterrupted gate-Q chip is literally the fuel for the heal that erases it. That inverts the usual advice: chip poke into a full Indestructible window is worse than no poke at all, and the right play is to poke in bursts through its 12-second rank-1 cooldown rather than continuously. _missing/jayce.json flags this matchup as anti-heal-relevant and nothing on the page acts on it.
audit.corrected: Poke in bursts around the 12s cooldown, and get Grievous Wounds down before the extended trades — the shield is built from your own chip.

audit.why: The page's central mistake-callout — walking up to throw Shock Blast inside his E range — is the right one and is not split by elo.

edits.before: His first AP item makes the E-pull into Obliterate-into-R all-in lethal, and recasting Indestructible heals back your Shock Blast chip faster than you can re-stack the gate-Q — your poke margin shrinks hard here.
edits.after: His first AP item makes the 16s E-pull into Obliterate-into-R lethal, and Indestructible is built out of the damage you deal him — continuous chip just feeds the shield he recasts as a heal, so poke in bursts.

edits.before: Land E (Death's Grasp) to drag you off the gate and out of cannon range, gluing you inside Obliterate for the Darkness Rise aura to grind
edits.after: Land Death's Grasp (700 range, 16s at rank 1) to drag you off the gate into Obliterate range for the Darkness Rise aura to grind

edits.before: Bank Indestructible off your Shock Blast poke and recast it as a heal so your gate-accelerated chip never compounds into a kill
edits.after: Build Indestructible out of the very Shock Blast chip you land, then recast it as a heal so the poke never compounds into a kill

edits.before: Level 3 is his — Death's Grasp plus Obliterate plus a banked Indestructible drags me off the gate into his Q and the Darkness Rise aura out-grinds my Shock Blast chip.
edits.after: Level 3 is his — Death's Grasp (700 range, 16s) drags you off the gate into Obliterate, and the Indestructible your own chip built out-grinds the poke.

edits.before: - Mordekaiser Realm of Death: matchup-defining — His 1v1 realm. Avoid fighting low. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Realm of Death: 140s at rank 1, 650 range — spent, you own the next two minutes. - Death's Grasp: 16s at rank 1, 700 range, the pull that starts everything. Stay past 700 and neither can reach you. - Indestructible: 12s.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Death's Grasp pulls from 700 units and is 16s at rank 1 — wait it.

edits.before: Gate-Q Mordekaiser's step-up, swap to hammer if he closes, E-knockback the dive, and swap back to re-poke.
edits.after: Gate-Q from past 700 units, Thundering Blow him off if he pulls, then swap to cannon and re-poke the 16s.

notes: The packet flags `wants.foe[1]` 'Bank Indestructible' as a probable wrong ability name — it is a false positive. Indestructible is the correct name; the near-miss was the verb 'Bank' being read as part of it. I rewrote that line anyway, for the shield-is-built-from-your-own-damage mechanic rather than the name. Separately: this whole matchup's `early`/`mid`/`late` and all seven `whys` are written in FIRST person ('Levels 1-2 are mine', 'I have to cash them in') where every other Jayce matchup uses second person. I converted the two `whys` I touched; a voice pass over the remaining strings is a bigger job than an in-band edit allows and is worth doing as its own run.
